title: Subscription
description: An agreement between a buyer and a Business under which the Business places recurring orders for the buyer. A current-state snapshot: the line items that recur and the terms in effect, the Order that started it, the Orders placed under it, and the orders the Business plans to place.

id.description: Opaque identifier the Business assigns to the subscription. Stable for the life of the subscription and never reused.

label.description: Human-readable label for identifying the subscription. MUST only be provided by the business.

status.description: Current state of the subscription. Well-known values: `active` (the Business places recurring orders as scheduled), `paused` (no recurring order is placed until the subscription resumes), `canceled` (the buyer or the Business ended the subscription; no further recurring order is placed), `ended` (the subscription ran to its stated end; no further recurring order is placed). Platforms MUST tolerate unknown values.

permalink_url.description: Permalink to the subscription on the Business's site, where the buyer manages it.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of every amount on the subscription.

initial_order.description: The Order that started the subscription. Present when an Order started it and the Business can identify that Order.

id.description: ID of the Order that started the subscription.

line_item_ids.description: IDs of the Order line items the subscription was started from.

line_items.description: The line items the Business places recurring orders for together under this subscription, each with the terms currently in effect.

orders.description: References to the Orders that belong to the subscription, most recent first: the Order that started it, when there is one, and each recurring Order the Business has placed under it. A Business MAY list only the most recent. Absent or empty when no Order exists yet.

upcoming_orders.description: The recurring orders the Business plans to place, next one first. They are not Orders yet and carry no `id`. Absent or empty when none is planned.
